# Email the Markdown brief to the owner as Deloitte-styled HTML, keeping only links found in the thread data. import html import json import bs4 import markdown from semoss import Insight FONT = "Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" # Deloitte palette: black, Deloitte green (accents only; too light for text), cool grays, accessible link blue. BLACK = "#000000" GREEN = "#86BC25" GRAY_TEXT = "#53565A" GRAY_LINE = "#D0D0CE" GRAY_FILL = "#F2F2F2" BLUE = "#0076A8" # Outlook ignores most stylesheet CSS, so every element gets inline styles. STYLES = { "h1": "margin:24px 0 8px; padding:0 0 6px; border-bottom:2px solid " + GREEN + "; font-size:20px; font-weight:bold; color:" + BLACK + ";", "h2": "margin:24px 0 8px; padding:0 0 6px; border-bottom:2px solid " + GREEN + "; font-size:18px; font-weight:bold; color:" + BLACK + ";", "h3": "margin:16px 0 6px; font-size:15px; font-weight:bold; color:" + BLACK + ";", "p": "margin:0 0 10px;", "ul": "margin:0 0 12px; padding:0 0 0 20px;", "ol": "margin:0 0 12px; padding:0 0 0 20px;", "li": "margin:0 0 6px;", "a": "color:" + BLUE + "; text-decoration:underline;", "strong": "color:" + BLACK + ";", "table": "border-collapse:collapse; width:100%; margin:0 0 12px;", "th": "padding:6px 8px; border:1px solid " + GRAY_LINE + "; background:" + GRAY_FILL + "; text-align:left;", "td": "padding:6px 8px; border:1px solid " + GRAY_LINE + ";", "blockquote": "margin:0 0 12px; padding:4px 12px; border-left:3px solid " + GREEN + "; color:" + GRAY_TEXT + ";", "code": "font-family:Consolas, monospace; background:" + GRAY_FILL + "; padding:1px 4px;", "hr": "border:0; border-top:1px solid " + GRAY_LINE + "; margin:16px 0;", } REPLY_STYLE = ("margin:4px 0 8px; padding:8px 12px; list-style:none; background:" + GRAY_FILL + "; border-left:3px solid " + GREEN + "; color:" + GRAY_TEXT + ";") def _urls(value, found): if isinstance(value, str): if value.startswith("http://") or value.startswith("https://"): found.add(value) elif isinstance(value, dict): for item in value.values(): _urls(item, found) elif isinstance(value, list): for item in value: _urls(item, found) return found def _pixel_value(name, value): # Pixel decodes \u escapes, so mail text can never open an tag in the Pixel. return name + "=[" + json.dumps(value).replace("<", "\\u003c") + "]" def _email(content, date): return ( '' '
' '' '' '' '' '' '
' 'Deloitte' '.' '
Morning Work Briefing · ' + html.escape(date) + '
' '
 
' + content + '
' 'Prepared by SEMOSS Collaboration from your Brain topics and recent threads. ' 'Links open the original message in Outlook or Teams.' '
' ) def run(scope): recipient = str(scope.get("owner_email") or "").strip() if not recipient: raise ValueError("The brief has no owner mailbox address to send to.") # Escape raw HTML first, so only Markdown formatting reaches the email. escaped = str(scope["brief"]).replace("&", "&").replace("<", "<") soup = bs4.BeautifulSoup(markdown.markdown(escaped, extensions=["tables"]), "html.parser") allowed = _urls(scope["threads"], set()) for image in soup.find_all("img"): image.decompose() for link in soup.find_all("a"): if link.get("href") not in allowed: link.unwrap() for tag in soup.find_all(list(STYLES)): tag["style"] = STYLES[tag.name] for item in soup.find_all("li"): if item.get_text().lstrip().lower().startswith("suggested reply"): item["style"] = REPLY_STYLE date = str(scope["date"]) pixel = "MicrosoftOutlookSendMail(" + ", ".join([ _pixel_value("to", [recipient]), _pixel_value("subject", "Morning Work Briefing - " + date), _pixel_value("body", _email(str(soup), date)), _pixel_value("html", True), ]) + ");" ret = Insight().run_pixel(pixel, raw=True) last = ret[0]["pixelReturn"][-1] if "ERROR" in str(last.get("operationType")): raise RuntimeError("Sending the brief failed: " + str(last.get("output"))) return {"sent": True, "to": recipient}
